author: _Striker13_
body: Hi, I am appealing for being banned on your server. On July 8, 2014, I was banned for hacking. The thing is, it wasn't me playing. It was my friend that was playing on my account with hacks. He was once banned for using hacks for his account. For proof, his minecraft username is Chapack. The day before I was banned, I logged onto my account on his cp. I forgot to exit out of my account and am he used it on your server. Please allow me to be unbanned. Before I was banned, I loved playing on your server and it was my favorite server out of each one. I know it has been a long since I have been banned but I'd really appreciate it if you would let me. Thank you for reading this and I hope you are doing well.
